"#000"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"，需要打击。"}]},{"type":"collapse","attrs":{"active":false,"dataDiffId":"8d2cd0da-ef83-4851-bd6b-660ab7069541","id":"5663555638f847d883d28b9a6e58f68b","nodeId":"b64a16c75c4246bb84d0b9003e32ff9d"},"content":[{"type":"collapse_title","attrs":{"align":"","nodeId":"160bb0d96e1a4914b7b6c654909cd285"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}},{"type":"strong"}],"text":"国家法律政策负面（适用于定义3）"}]},{"type":"collapse_content","attrs":{"nodeId":"a87558c868fd4dd088afd9a79bd62a50"},"content":[{"type":"bullet_list","attrs":{"indent":0,"dataDiffId":"460bf4e9-9a1c-4de3-9812-f82d41e8cced","nodeId":"35a9620180be4a8d9990b4819d31d65e"},"content":[{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-e1f5ead4-60a0-4265-ba6d-9fe7173c5af7","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"a33dcbff49894057adaab70671f78574"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"eb718636-148f-4ce0-bb70-2e274f40f130","nodeId":"c7b6c73c00944830a9d695061f12b2ab"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"吸毒记录封存的条例属于《中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法》，治安违法记录封存针对的是“尚不构成刑事处罚”的行政违法行为，如吸毒、殴打他人、赌博等，核心是“限制公开与常规查询”，记录本身仍完整留存于公安系统，并未被彻底删除。以吸毒行为为例，若仅因吸食少量毒品被行政拘留，其记录适用封存制度；若因走私、贩卖毒品构成犯罪，则需纳入刑事犯罪记录管理，不适用此封存规则。吸毒行为是违法，不是犯罪；贩毒或制造毒品是犯罪行为，刑法对这类行为的打击力度很大。吸食毒品是治安违法行为，如果吸食毒品，治安管理处罚法对其处以最高15天的拘留处罚。"}]}]},{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-97ea545c-3acc-45c2-84b0-d562f69de5b3","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"719588d6eafd491884987de01b0cfe98"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"aa035183-b3bc-44c6-9422-a040ecbcbec3","nodeId":"8a6b9525fe2b456d8f53c607f101bf3e"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"将于明年1月1日起实施，其中第一百三十六条规定，违反治安管理的记录应当予以封存，不得向任何单位和个人提供或者公开，但有关国家机关为办案需要或者有关单位根据国家规定进行查询的除外。依法进行查询的单位，应当对被封存的违法记录的情况予以保密。"}]}]},{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-fc5f9a18-7498-4024-b2ff-bd7f6b347a9f","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"d082fcfd2cd34a8198eda9c850ddbd46"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"cb248aaa-14e8-4469-9bcd-ea8c90111fff","nodeId":"3b10d3e38cc94deda6d9c4693ad28856"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"目前我国对吸毒人员的管理一直实行“动态管控”，公安机关会对戒毒人员进行定期回访、检测。禁毒法明确规定，对吸毒人员，要提供社会复归的机会。不是说封存就意味着要对吸毒的行为进行法律上的轻纵，放弃了对吸毒行为的打击、对毒品的管控。记录封存并不是“风险隐身”，公众担心的“吸毒者从事限制性职业”问题，目前在法律层面已有多重防线，记录封存不会削弱职业准入监管。违法记录，包括犯罪记录，实际上是被执法机关、司法机关登记在案的，并没有完全消除。治安管理处罚法的违法记录封存，并不影响执法机关依法登记吸毒人员，也不影响在戒毒的过程中对他们的信息进行保护。"}]}]}]}]}]}]},{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-3643a612-d9f1-4c1f-8eec-2de7d6a36779","fontSize":15,"value":null,"nodeId":"1385db1083714dd796df1a8eb3307e6e"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"c24a5a33-f58b-4459-a4ea-3fc9c0e90947","nodeId":"3564b59c770c46148839809c6bbffcf3"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"批评法律不健全、宣扬法律不公平的，只偏向部分人群的"}]}]},{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-e513d279-13c0-4492-9ef3-29d161942b8b","fontSize":15,"value":null,"nodeId":"720f6a8c5f8e4086b1c351dbcd4b8eef"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"557ea645-ab7e-40fe-9519-d1227b5d18cc","nodeId":"89f3dee43c844b56a34334cb5147fa06"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"批评教育政策转向的言论"}]}]},{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":fal
